review: Independent cross-review of the real X11 shared-window driver repair

reviewed_changes: Per-native-output placement declaration snapshot in App
Query-before-move guard around the existing physical xdotool drag
Direct ICCCM WM_PROTOCOLS/WM_DELETE_WINDOW request for the final Root close
scope.method: Read-only source and dependency semantics review, with caller-supplied diagnostic logs

coverage.result: The consumer-side race is corrected without changing the production multipass guard.
evidence: App snapshots Shared.shifted on the first UI call for a new NativeOutputToken and reuses that bool while token equality holds.

The pinned eframe host_seam.rs begin_output (2621-2674) mints one token with a fresh nonce and keeps it active until NativeOutputScope leaves. glow_integration.rs (869 onward) opens that scope before epi_integration.rs (398) runs run_ui_with_pass_finalizer.
epi_integration.rs (379-396) invokes App.ui only for the Root; deferred Child callbacks execute their own viewport_ui_cb, so their tokens do not overwrite App.placement_run.

crates/egui_dockspace_native/src/surface_driver/root_placements.rs:413-414 still rejects a changed valid declaration during a repeated run. crates/egui_dockspace_native/src/app.rs:474 still documents equal repeated rosters.
/tmp/dockspace-release-multipass-yield-red-repeat.log:24-25 identifies RootPlacements::declare at line 414; line 135 records HostProtocol(MultipassOutputChanged), followed by EXIT 1.

coverage.topic: Placement change remains part of the real journey
coverage.result: The snapshot delays adoption until a later output; it does not suppress the placement-change assertion.
evidence: The driver still sets shifted=true after Child -> B, then waits for shifted_ready before requesting the layout reset.
shifted_ready still requires both surfaces presented and completed Root geometry from a different output token with the changed origin and scale.
A periodic 10 ms repaint remains, allowing the new desired declaration to be adopted on subsequent output tokens.

coverage.result: The no-op movement guard removes the known --sync stall while preserving real pointer/button delivery.
evidence: The guard compares requested global coordinates against XQueryPointer root_x/root_y, rather than against cached pane or intended pointer positions.
If the coordinates differ it still executes xdotool mousemove --sync with the same target. Only an already-reached coordinate omits the motion request.
drag still performs mousedown 1, all twelve interpolation iterations with their original 25 ms pauses, the original 250 ms dwell, and mouseup 1.
x11rb-protocol 0.13.2 xproto.rs:13440-13456 defines root_x/root_y as the actual pointer coordinates relative to the logical root.
The three docking transitions still use drag and still wait for observed item ownership/presentation; no semantic docking action or synthetic egui/winit pointer input was substituted.

coverage.topic: X11 close message construction and delivery
coverage.result: The final close uses the normal ICCCM client protocol with the actual Root client XID.
evidence: ClientMessageEvent uses format 32, type WM_PROTOCOLS, data[0]=WM_DELETE_WINDOW, data[1]=CURRENT_TIME, and the Root client window as both event.window and send_event destination.
send_event uses propagate=false and EventMask::NO_EVENT, the direct client delivery convention for a window protocol message. Request errors are checked and the connection is flushed.
Pinned winit revision 2664589 event_processor.rs:765-778 turns a ClientMessage with data[0]=wm_delete_window into WindowEvent::CloseRequested for that exact XID.
The changed code does not call XDestroyWindow, windowclose, windowkill, or a process termination API.

coverage.result: The close continues through the native held-close/Allow path.
evidence: The app still installs dockspace.native_host_handler() in NativeOptions.native_host.
Pinned eframe run.rs:519-547 calls observe_window_event before ordinary renderer event handling; HoldClose schedules repaint and prevents immediate Root CloseRequested shutdown.
crates/egui_dockspace_native/src/mailbox.rs:4308-4314 produces HoldClose for a bound native close request and captures the event; close_control.rs:146 onward qualifies the exact close request.

crates/egui_dockspace_native/src/coordinator.rs:1785 onward publishes the requested native close; coordinator/effect_dispatch.rs:326-327 resolves an accepted close through NativeViewportCloseDecision::Allow.
Pinned eframe host_seam.rs:2420 onward settles held decisions, and epi_integration.rs:435 invokes root shutdown only when that settlement allows it.

/tmp/dockspace-release-shared-close-original-red.log:16-18 records retained requests increasing from 0 to 1 after the discriminating protocol close. /tmp/dockspace-release-shared-close-discriminating-control.log records the stalled attempt, the exact WM_PROTOCOLS/WM_DELETE_WINDOW message, and rc_after_true_WM_DELETE=0.

coverage.topic: Success cannot be inferred from the journey log or an external kill alone
coverage.result: The in-process final result retains its explicit completion/error checks.
evidence: run waits for the driver, propagates the eframe result, rejects Shared.error, and rejects an incomplete journey before returning Ok.
request_close failures propagate from drive and are stored in Shared.error by the driver wrapper, even though completed is set before that call.
The App timeout records an error, so its own timeout-driven Close cannot turn into a successful final result.
The preexisting Alt+F4 failure cleanup remains, but it is not the final success close path and cannot clear Shared.error.

coverage.result: No temporary yield or diagnostic instrumentation remains in the reviewed file.
evidence: The diff against 7555bea contains only the three driver fixes and placement_run initialization.
An exact-file search found no temporary DOCKSPACE_DIAG/yield instrumentation or destructive close API.
git diff --check 7555bea -- integration/egui-native-smoke/src/bin/shared_window/app.rs passed.

dependencies_checked.source: Pinned workspace Cargo configuration and local Cargo git/registry cache only

limits: No Cargo build, test, clippy, or formatter was run, as instructed.
No additional X11 app run or pointer/close event was launched by this reviewer; the caller owns final clean ordinary and late-discard runtime acceptance.
Diagnostic logs were inspected as root-cause/control evidence; their temporary instrumentation does not constitute acceptance evidence for the final clean source.
The approximately 19-second xdotool no-op --sync delay was reported by the caller and was not independently timed in this review.

The direct WM_DELETE_WINDOW request covers the X11 client protocol, Winit close event, native retention, and approval flow; it does not test window-manager Alt+F4 shortcut mapping or focus activation.
Neither timeout termination nor forced process cleanup is counted as a natural successful exit in this review.
docs/reviews/** and repo-ref/** were not read or searched. No source, documentation, Cargo file, commit, or subagent was created or modified; the only write is this requested /tmp artifact.
